ID_O_BATTLEPOINTS_INTRO_TEXT: By scoring kills and completing objectives you earn Battle Points which can be spent on special characters.
ID_O_BUYCRATES_TEXT:
You have earned enough CREDITS to purchase a CRATE!

Crates contain different types of cosmetic items such as skins, emotes and victory poses.
ID_O_COLLECTION_TEXT:
Here you will find all characters and starfighters available for you to play.

ALL of them can be customized with STAR CARDS. Some have additional weapon customization as well.
ID_O_COMBAT_ABILITIES_TEXT: Press %%ABILITYINFO%% while playing as any character to check your abilities.
ID_O_CRAFT_TEXT:
Star Cards can boost or replace character abilities. Each character and starfighter can have up to three cards equipped at any time. You can UNLOCK Star Cards by using Skill Points.

Skill Points are class-specific and received each time you gain enough XP to gain a level.
ID_O_CRATES_TEXT:
You have unopened CRATES!

You will earn crates daily when you start the game.
ID_O_CUSTOMIZE_ABILITIES_TEXT:
Every character and starfighter always has three ABILITIES that are unique to them.

Press ABILITY DETAILS to read about them and use them in-game right from the start.
ID_O_EDITCARDS_TEXT:
Star Cards can either boost the unique ABILITIES or replace them completely.

Each character and starfighter can have up to 3 cards equipped.
ID_O_EQUIP_STARCARDS_DESC: In Arcade all Star Cards are unlocked on the highest level.
ID_O_SKILLPOINTS_TEXT: You have one or more Skill Points to use on your characters! Head to the Collection screen to unlock or upgrade a Star Card.
ID_O_SWITCHCHARACTER_TEXT: Some characters share unique abilities and belong to a class. Star Cards customize that class and thus apply to all characters within the class.
ID_O_TROOPER_SPAWN_TEXT: Pick a Trooper class to bring into battle.
